title: Quick Pungent Filipino Beef Bistek
description: A pungent and flaky Filipino dish featuring Italian seasoning, this bistek is a hangover cure and diabetic friendly, cooked in a tandoor clay pot.

ingredients.name: candy
ingredients.notes: such as gummy bears or sour candies

instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together Italian seasoning, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, black pepper, and salt.
Add the sliced beef to the bowl and marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Remove the beef from the marinade and cook in the preheated tandoor clay pot for 5 minutes per side.
Add the candy to the pot and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the olive oil and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the bistek hot, garnished with additional Italian seasoning if desired.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Slice the bistek into thin strips and serve immediately.
